title: DRRA Canonical Incident Event
description: The single versioned event envelope every DRRA producer emits and every consumer reads (DRRA-002). Producer-specific vocabularies (the Rust watcher's FileModificationEvent, OTRF/Sysmon telemetry, and the backend detection/telemetry models) map onto this envelope via documented adapters. See docs/EVENT_SCHEMA.md.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this envelope. Consumers reject an event whose major version they do not understand.

occurred_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the observed activity happened (source clock).

ingested_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when DRRA received the event (receiver clock). Enables clock-skew accounting (DRRA-008).

category.description: Coarse classification of what the event represents.

action.description: The specific action within the category (e.g. create, modify, remove, rename, logon, process_access, contain, restore).

subject.description: The entity the action was performed on. All fields optional; populate what the producer observed.

signals.description: Measured numeric signals. Keys are stable across producers so the detector and dashboard read one vocabulary.

labels.description: Free-form string key/value tags (e.g. tenant, campaign, rule id). Never used for authorization decisions.

raw_ref.description: Pointer back to the untransformed source event for forensics and chain of custody (DRRA-043).
